title: Home Brain web app — Phase 0/1 mock-up

t1.text: Home Brain web app — Sprint 14 mock-up

s1.text:
Clickable on the Console (Play):
• Home → Needs you → Open the budget gate. Edit amounts (decimal comma works; letters are refused), Save → the run continues and reports.
• The Slack-started gate shows a run answered on the web.
• Command bar: type “manage budget” and send.
• Phase 1 (labelled): Expenses grid and Recipe document — edit, add, delete, Save.
• EN / ES switch: the app's words and number formats change; your data does not.

All names and amounts are invented sample data.
